sol.fix: Change src/object.rs::const_literal. The determining text is §3.3 "reg[N] ... a location (oracle bodies, lprocs); not linear" together with §4.2 "w = lift.const.iN c" and the already recorded SPEC-QUESTIONS 12/15 range/width readings. Validate a literal using storage proportional to its magnitude spelling and compare its bit length/magnitude to N; do not allocate N+1 bits just to validate a small literal, do not compute unchecked w+1, and do not collapse representation/storage errors into out-of-range. For positive 1 at either supplied N, admission must succeed and retain the exact pins above. Add library tests under catch_unwind requiring Object::parse plus check_hashes to succeed for both complete witness objects; add CLI check/hash controls requiring exit 0/status ok and those identities. Keep ordinary out-of-range literals rejected (e.g. i8 256 and i8 -129), and include negative/zero controls at the extreme widths. Actual execution needing an unrepresentable location may return a cited host-resource Result error, never panic or claim literal 1 is out of range. No arbitrary ISA width cap and no spec amendment.
